QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_15

question.text: Per the Series-XIX-B workbook (pp. 36, 52, 105), the continuing-interest (sponsor/manager skin-in-the-game) requirement for a Category III AIF is:

answer.text: Lower of 2% of corpus or Rs. 5 crore
Lower of 5% of corpus or Rs. 10 crore
Lower of 10% of corpus or Rs. 20 crore
Higher of 5% of corpus or Rs. 25 crore

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook pages cited (pp. 36, 52, 105), the sponsor / manager continuing-interest requirement for a Category III AIF is the LOWER of 5% of corpus or Rs. 10 crore. This is the source-anchored Cat III figure. The Trap: Option A is a fabricated lower figure. Option C overstates the 5%/10 crore threshold. Option D inverts "lower" to "higher" and changes the rupee cap; the Regulations use the LOWER-of formulation. Note: The original item asked WHY Cat III's sponsor commitment is larger than Cat I/II's, but the workbook pages checked did not state the Cat I/II 2.5%/Rs. 5 crore comparison amount, nor did they explicitly explain the larger Cat III commitment as a consequence of leverage / risk. The item has been reworded to ask for the Cat III continuing-interest requirement itself, which IS directly stated in the workbook, making the keyed answer source-supported. Source: Series-XIX-B AIF (Category III) Distributors-December workbook, pp. 36, 52, 105.
